# workflow-engine-lite

> Durable workflow instances as validated state machines: persisted state, event transitions, timeout timers fired by tick, event dedup and optimistic concurrency Python package `trysac-workflow-engine-lite`, import name `workflow_engine_lite`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
